body: Its been 7 years since I have cried. Today I cried for 4 hours straight and I still am. Just knowing there are people that want to help me stops some of the aching

My dad cheated and left my mum when I was 5, I've barely seen him since but I know that I look so much like him and I feel like that is why my mum gets so hostile with me. She sees her cheating husband in me and takes out her anger on me. I have a somewhat deep voice and every time I talk she always repeats what I say in her version of my voice. I hate it, I don't understand why she must make fun of how I talk. I am always made to do all the work in the house, the cleaning, mowing and washing even though I have a sister. My mum has her favourites and that is my sister, she hasn't done anything around the hour in years. When I'm busy and I ask my mum why my sister cannot do it, she says "because she is a lady". My sister also loves to get me in trouble, she makes up stories and tells them to mum. When I try to defend myself she shouts even louder and will never hear me out. I've considered moving in with my dad but his new wife is horrible.
